name: What design considerations are important for an ADU to maximize its functionality and value?

mainEntity.name: What design considerations are important for an ADU to maximize its functionality and value?

acceptedAnswer.text: When designing an ADU, consider its intended use and integrate flexible spaces that can adapt over time. Maximize natural light and ventilation to create a comfortable living environment. Efficient use of space, including built-in storage and compact appliances, is crucial for smaller units. Consider features like a separate entrance for privacy, energy-efficient systems, and durable, low-maintenance materials to enhance long-term value and appeal. A thoughtful design can significantly impact an ADU's usability and marketability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key ADU design considerations include flexible spaces, natural light, efficient layouts, built-in storage, separate entrances, and energy-efficient features to maximize functionality and value.
